verses.label: Verse 1
lines: How I wonder what you are!
Up above the world so high,
Like a diamond in the sky.
How I wonder what you are!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: 一闪一闪亮晶晶满天都是小星星

exclusions.reason: Galvin, 2026-10-04: the low dip after 睛 (voice slides E4 down to a steady A3, 69.43-70.01 s, then back up to D4) is not part of the tune; the player is not judged on it. The game has no shown-but-unscored note, so the dip is left out of the chart.

review.note: 2026-10-03: Galvin listened to both verses on the listening page and said the song seems correct (with the wordless low note after 睛 shown). That note (69.43-70.01 s) is the singer's voice sliding from E4 down to a steady A3 and back up to D4; it was briefly deleted on a misreading of Galvin's remark and restored the same day. Not yet confirmed by playing it in the game. 2026-10-04: Galvin chose not to score the low dip; it is now an exclusion.
